urbanLiveAction.title: Urban live-action short drama
urbanLiveAction.description: Neutral urban tones, real East Asian actors and everyday costumes and props. Consistent natural light, urban textures and restrained performances suit workplace and relationship stories.

periodLiveAction.title: Period costume / live action
periodLiveAction.description: Choose a single historical period, then unify makeup, hairstyles, dress codes, objects and architecture. Muted Eastern colors and material details establish authenticity.

suspenseNoir.title: Crime mystery night
suspenseNoir.description: A dark blue and black low-light palette with sparing danger colors. Consistent urban night textures, practical lighting and psychological tension support mysteries and twists.

inkNarrative.title: Ink wash narrative
inkNarrative.description: Dominant rice-paper negative space, with dense ink, light washes and touches of cinnabar. Consistent outlines, brushwork and color accents distinguish characters without turning them into unrecognizable ink shapes.

threeDCartoon.title: 3D cartoon short drama
threeDCartoon.description: Stylized 3D characters with distinct silhouettes, soft materials and bright colors. Readable expressions, exaggerated timing and consistent assets support comedy, family and uplifting stories.

futureTech.title: Future tech
futureTech.description: Clean white and gray spaces, precise industrial structures and restrained cool lighting create a believable near future. Technology comes from function and materials, without relying on neon or floating interfaces.

cyberpunkNeon.title: Cyber neon
cyberpunkNeon.description: Dense Asian night cities, damp aged surfaces and controlled neon create a near future shaped by technological imbalance. Implants, class-specific clothing and corporate colors distinguish characters.

retroHongKong.title: Retro Hong Kong
retroHongKong.description: Film colors, dense city blocks and everyday clothing evoke Chinese-speaking cities of the 1980s and 1990s. Warm tungsten light, teal shadows and authentic period objects build nostalgia.

clayStopMotion.title: Clay stop motion
clayStopMotion.description: Clay characters with visible hand-sculpted marks, miniature sets and stop-motion movement. Consistent proportions, material grain and lighting scale create a warm, tactile handmade world.

blackWhiteNoir.title: Black-and-white silent film
blackWhiteNoir.description: Black-and-white tones, hard lighting and restrained acting make drama readable without dialogue. Composition, materials and performance establish period character without relying on retro filters.

spaceOpera.title: Space opera
spaceOpera.description: An epic interstellar scale and distinct faction clothing combine with believable aerospace structures. Color, insignia and materials support political and adventure stories without piling on cosmic spectacle.

comicPop.title: Comic panels
comicPop.description: High-contrast shapes, halftone textures and comic panel rhythms create readable action comedy. Composition, sound effects and poses bring exaggeration while character assets remain consistent.

storybookFantasy.title: Picture-book fairy tale
storybookFantasy.description: Paper grain, soft color blocks and hand-drawn edges create a warm fairy-tale world. Clear expressions and silhouettes preserve the picture-book feel without generic soft-focus effects.

surrealDream.title: Surreal dream
surrealDream.description: Realistic materials meet impossible spaces. Mirrors, distorted scale and hazy light express dreams, with every surreal change serving a character's psychology or narrative clues.

natureHealing.title: Natural and healing
natureHealing.description: Natural light, plants and handmade everyday life create a relaxed sense of place. Seasons, sound and small actions convey healing without advertising-style scenic shots.

realLifeDocumentary.title: Everyday documentary
realLifeDocumentary.description: Natural earth and gray tones, ordinary East Asian people and local Chinese living spaces. Environmental traces and an observational film style lend credibility to family and social stories.

xianxia.label: Xianxia
xianxia.description: Sects, immortal cities, secluded dwellings, seas of clouds and rules of magic create an Eastern cultivation world.

urban.label: Contemporary urban
urban.description: Modern drama grounded in believable Chinese cities, professional identities and everyday relationships.

historical.label: Historical
historical.description: Choose one period, then unify etiquette, costumes, props, objects and architecture.

suspense.label: Mystery and crime
suspense.description: Real urban textures, a coherent system of clues and psychological pressure form a readable mystery world.

scienceFiction.label: Futuristic science fiction
scienceFiction.description: Rules of technology, social structures and functional spaces support stories of the future.

pastoral.label: Nature and countryside
pastoral.description: Place, seasons, everyday work and the natural environment all take part in the story.

epic.label: Epic
epic.description: Scale, order and characters' destinies create an epic feel without constant darkness or excessive effects.

dark.label: Dark and uncanny
dark.description: The unknown, taboos and psychological pressure create a dark tone while keeping information readable.

lightComedy.label: Light comedy
lightComedy.description: Grand situations contrast with characters' earnest reactions. The imagery is bright without feeling childish.

romantic.label: Romantic
romantic.description: Character distance, light and environmental details express changing relationships without sugary filters.

healing.label: Warm and healing
healing.description: Everyday actions, tactile surroundings and repaired relationships create warmth beyond generic soft lighting.

liveAction.label: Live action
liveAction.description: Real actors, believable optics, costumes, props and physical environments.

item3dAnime.label: 3D anime
item3dAnime.description: High-quality 3D animation, Eastern anime character design and cinematic environments.

item3dCartoon.label: 3D cartoon
item3dCartoon.description: Stylized proportions, clear silhouettes, soft materials and readable expressions.

item2dGuoman.label: Chinese 2D animation
item2dGuoman.description: Consistent linework, cel-shaded characters and Eastern painted environments.

ink.label: Ink animation
ink.description: Rice paper, ink tones, brushwork and negative space create recognizable Eastern narratives.

realistic.label: Realistic characters
realistic.description: Natural bone structure, age, skin and body proportions.

semiReal.label: Semi-realistic characters
semiReal.description: Eastern bone structure balances idealized design while retaining believable anatomy.

anime.label: Anime characters
anime.description: Elongated proportions, distinct facial designs and consistent silhouettes.

stylized.label: Stylized cartoon
stylized.description: Exaggerated proportions and readable expressions support comedy and lighthearted stories.
